description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecAllowlist functionality within the OpenClaw project, focusing on verifying command resolution, pattern matching, and security policies for executable whitelists on macOS. It defines fixtures, mock functions, and test cases to ensure correct behavior of command parsing, path resolution, and allowlist matching.
